verdicts.reason: A stretches the circle backdrop into a tall oval that is cut by the top and bottom edges. That distorts the key image, and the 'SOLSTICE' label on the can becomes unreadable. Its one-line headline is also weak, the badges and CTA float at the top-right, and the bottom of the canvas is left as dead space. B keeps the circle round and gives the two-line headline real presence, but the GLACIER logo is centred and doesn't line up with the left edge of the headline. The CTA and body copy are also jammed near the bottom edge, and the CTA column sits low and separate from the copy column.
